notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - New Content!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!   It's been little more than 2 months since launch and we're still gathering feedback and ideas for upcoming updates. This first content drop includes the following:

3 NEW Crewmates! – Rescue Fiona, Saru and Ctharlos starting from Zone 2. Excited to see how players find new ways to abuse their abilities.

The Roulette of Doom – It's always been the plan to explore the game's Risk versus Reward mechanics further. Now when the Curse meter is full, instead of triggering a flat buff on all creeps, you take a chance with the Roulette!

notes.title: Plot Your Course – New Demo Live + Launch Date Announced!
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers! 🧠⚓
We’re thrilled to be part of the Thinky Direct x Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025 with a fresh new build of Sunken Stones! Demo Update v0.0.7c is now live and packed with smart tweaks, cleaner systems, and a bit more salt. 🧂

Sunken Stones launches on July 18, 2025! 🏴‍☠️📅
Mark your maps and steady your ships—we’re almost ready to set sail.
[previewyoutube=XRaslFuAKqw;full][/previewyoutube]

Update Highlights

Fixed a series of crew-related bugs and edge case issues—less weirdness, more tactics
Tile details now available on hover – get the info you need before making your move
Updated Options menu with better layout and more control for your session
Added Stat Change History system – track buffs and nerfs mid-combat
The 3rd Captain has returned from exile, along with the base Salt crew!


Sharpen your minds and ready your crew—strategy has never looked sharper. 🧩

notes.title: Steam Next Fest 2025 Feedback & Fixes - Demo Update (0.0.6i)
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers! 🌊
Thank you all for playing the demo as a part of Feb 2025 Next Fest event!
Created a small patch addressing some of the issues persons have reported.

Update Highlights  

Choppiness/Slowness addressed - removed a FPS limiter that I suspect was the source for the slowdown
Updated the tutorial - so that you don't get soft locked when trying to learn how to "BLOCK"
Updated audio controls - Should no longer be 'NaN' or reset between screens/scenes

Thank you for all your feedback so far and keep-em coming!

notes.title: Indiecade 2024 Steam Showcase x Demo Update (0.0.6f)
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers! 🌊
We’re excited to share that there is a new patch to the demo for Sunken Stones!

Update Highlights  

Captain Tyson’s Ability: Ammo cost removed! 
Supply Boon Update: The Supply Boon now includes Harpoons
New Crew Added: The available crew count has been boosted to 60. Unlock these additional crew members through the Raffle Bag on the Captain Select Screen.
Enhanced Tutorial Experience:

Increased timer for dialog bubbles during the tutorial, allowing players more time to read and respond.
Fixed a tutorial softlock issue that could occur if you triggered your ultimate too early.


Bug Fixes & Adjustments  

Resolved an issue where players could accidentally activate the Captain’s ability with an unintended click.
Boosted TENTACLE[LEFT] creep starting HP from 2 to 4 for an added challenge in Zone 1.
Addressed multiple crew-related bugs to ensure smoother gameplay across various situations.


Thank you for all your feedback, and we hope you enjoy the new updates to Sunken Stones as part of this year’s IndieCade Steam Showcase!

notes.title: Public Demo is Back (Version 0.0.5S)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I know it's been a minute but I'm back with an shiny new demo update.
This build includes a fair number of changes on the core gameplay in order to enhance the overall Sunken Stones experience:


 Added More Roguelike Spice: I've shifted away from explicit team composition to delve deeper into the roguelike roots of the game. This change aims to introduce more variance and test how it impacts overall strategy and decision making.
 Simplified Turn Orders: Turn orders have been streamlined into three distinct phases:

 Loot Phase: Open any chests you've gathered and on board any crew mates saved/discovered on your journey.
 Deploy Phase: Position your crew strategically on the board to combat Creeps.
 Enemy Phase: Face the challenges posed by the monster and hazard spawns.


 New Hazards Introduced: I've added rocks as environmental hazards. These obstacles encourage more nuanced decision-making and create interesting deployment choices, adding a new layer of depth to the gameplay.
 
 Expanded Crew Roster: The number of crew mates you can discover on your voyage has increased to 15, offering more diversity and strategic options.

 Relationship Progression System Temporarily Removed: I've temporarily sunset the relationship progression system as I explore other potential directions for character development and interaction.


I believe these updates will provide a fresh and engaging experience, encouraging players to experiment with new strategies and adapt to ever-changing challenges. I look forward to your feedback as you embark on your adventures in Sunken Stones!

More to come soon!

notes.title: 🌊 Attention, Sunken Stones Adventurers! 🌊
notes.content:
A quick update regarding the Sunken Stones public demo on Steam. We're incredibly thrilled to see the enthusiasm and support you've shown for our game as we continue to dive deeper into development. However, it's time for a temporary change.

The current demo version available on Steam will be taken down momentarily. Why, you ask? Well, it's because our development progress has been racing ahead, surpassing the content and features available in the current demo.

But fear not! This isn't goodbye forever. We're taking this step to ensure that when the demo resurfaces, it'll be a true reflection of the incredible strides we've made in the game's development.

- The Sunken Stones Development Team
